'''Thistledown Floats on the Whirlwind''' is a [[sword form]].

==Description==
This form involves leaping and spinning, such that the blade cuts horizontally.

==In practice==
[[Rand al'Thor]] used this form to decapitate an unnamed, unarmed female [[Darkfriend]] in the [[Murandy|Murandian]] hills while on his way to [[Tear]]. She was still mounted on her horse, so Rand would have had to leap fairly high to cut her neck.{{ref/book|3|36}}
